topic: AI voice cloning scams using just seconds of audio
title: They Can Clone Your Voice From 3 Seconds of Audio
description: AI-narrated commentary on how voice-cloning scams actually work and why a family code word is the one thing that still stops them. Educational, not a how-to.

hook_candidates.text: What if a scammer only needed three seconds of your voice to sound exactly like you on a phone call?
Voice cloning scams aren't science fiction anymore -- they're already being used to fake real emergency calls from family members.
Scammers can now clone your voice well enough to fool your family -- using just three seconds of audio from a video you posted.

beats.text: Scammers can now clone your voice well enough to fool your family -- using just three seconds of audio from a video you posted.
It's already being used in real scam calls -- fake emergencies, asking for money right now.
The AI doesn't need a studio recording. A random video or voicemail is enough to build the clone.
The fix: a family code word the AI can't know, since it only clones your voice, not your memories.
Would the voice alone be enough to convince you? Let me know below.
